maddeler.e:
افتحلوا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَحَلُوا (iftaḥalū) /if.ta.ħa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# اُفْتُحِلُوا (uftuḥilū) /uf.tu.ħi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# اِفْتَحِلُوا (iftaḥilū) /if.ta.ħi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
